job.job_description:
Senior AI / GenAI Software Engineer

Company: Siemens Healthineers
Experience: 5+ Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Location: Pune
Work Mode: [Hybrid }




Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced AI / GenAI Software Engineer with 5+ years of software engineering experience and strong expertise in Generative AI, NLP, Large Language Models (LLMs), Information Retrieval and RAG architectures.

The ideal candidate will have a strong production engineering mindset and experience taking AI solutions from experimentation to reliable, scalable enterprise applications.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop and maintain production-grade AI/GenAI applications using Python.
Develop enterprise solutions using LLMs, NLP, Prompt Engineering and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG).
Design and implement RAG, hybrid retrieval and GraphRAG architectures.
Work with vector search and information retrieval technologies, including OpenSearch or similar platforms.
Develop APIs and AI services using modern Python frameworks and practices.
Build automated AI evaluation pipelines to measure retrieval quality and LLM output quality.
Write clean, maintainable and typed Python code using modern Python features.
Develop comprehensive automated tests using pytest, mocking and unit/integration testing.
Follow software engineering best practices including Git, merge requests, code reviews, CI/CD and code quality checks.
Containerize and manage applications using Docker.
Work across the SDLC and CRISP-DM lifecycle, converting AI experiments into deterministic and production-ready software.
Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver practical AI solutions.
Continuously evaluate emerging GenAI technologies and identify opportunities for business/product improvement.

Mandatory Skills

5+ years of professional software engineering experience
Strong hands-on experience with Python
Strong experience in Generative AI / LLMs
Experience with NLP / Information Retrieval
Hands-on experience with RAG
Experience with Vector Search / Semantic Search
Experience with Hybrid Retrieval
Strong understanding of Prompt Engineering
Experience developing production-grade AI applications
Experience with pytest / automated testing
Experience with Git, code reviews and software development lifecycle
Experience with Docker / containerization

Preferred Skills

GraphRAG
OpenSearch
Pydantic
Async Python / async-await
FastAPI
Automated LLM/RAG evaluation
RAGAS / DeepEval / LangSmith or similar evaluation frameworks
AWS Bedrock
Azure OpenAI
Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Knowledge Graphs / Neo4j

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who:

Has a strong hands-on engineering mindset
Can build AI solutions beyond prototypes and notebooks
Understands how to take an AI experiment into production
Has strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Can explain complex AI concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Learns quickly and adapts to the rapidly evolving GenAI ecosystem
Takes ownership and works proactively
Focuses on practical, scalable and reliable solutions

Important

Candidates with only basic Python, generic Machine Learning, Data Science, Prompt Engineering or simple Chatbot experience may not be suitable.

Strong hands-on experience in RAG + LLM/GenAI + Python + production software engineering is highly preferred.
